comment.author: hbgangcn1
comment.body_excerpt: Leak confirmation from a second Windows host (OpenClaw 2026.9.9, npm global): `tmp/plugin-captures/` holds **443 UUID dirs totaling ~252 G ... sign should include a retention/GC policy for superseded captures — otherwise the "fix" for boot time becomes a disk-exhaustion incident.

reasons: On-topic disk-leak report with measurements and a retention-policy recommendation.
